messages:
Priya: kicking off async check for SlateHealth private cutover — goal: non-prod canary next Wed. TL;DR: network + image signing + KMS creds. Who owns cert rotation?
Alex: I will own cert rotation and image-signing checklist. I'll add the runbook steps.
Sam: NetOps — firewall rules mostly ready but we still need an egress NAT for healthchecks and a proxy exception for the prober IP. Who's validating the customer-side routing?
Jordan: CS confirms Slate will open 3 egress IPs (see ticket #SL-119). I'll attach the signed network form.
Maria: Oncall here — need to verify the prober can reach /healthz on the frontend LB after rules are applied. I can run smoke once NetOps gives the green.
Alex: Note: for airgapped sync we need to push signed images via their bastion. I'll provide an upload script and S3-compatible endpoint. Also need a small change to the signer to support --no-oci for their older runtime.
Sam: Also saw TLS handshake failures in staging with proxy SNI. Pasting the stub log: ```TLS handshake error: x509: certificate is valid for api.internal, not slate-proxy``` — likely cert SAN mismatch.
Priya: Quick ownership map: Alex = certs/image-signing, Sam = network & proxy, Maria = smoke & tracing, Jordan = CS comms/KMS. Confirm?
Jordan: confirmed. I'm also chasing HSM/KMS onboarding — customer said their infra team will provision credentials by Fri.
Alex: CR ping: PR #4827 (image-signer scripts) depends on infra/ssh-key-rotation PR. @Sam can you review the dependency?
Sam: I'll review both PRs by EOD and flag any blockers.
Maria: Observability ask: enable tenant-level tracing for Slate for 72h post-cutover. We'll need a flag in the rollout config. @Priya approve?
Priya: Approved. Please add it to the playbook under observability and include TTL.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: canary build 2024.11.3 queued for slate-staging.
Alex: Gating issue: image-signer cannot run in their offline environment until --no-oci is implemented; I'm pushing a patch to the PR now.
Sam: If egress is blocked, fallback should pull from internal mirror. Add a mirror fallback step to the sync runbook.
Priya: Action items (owner -> due): 1) Alex -> patch image-signer (today), 2) Sam -> review FW & proxy (EOD), 3) Jordan -> confirm KMS/HSM creds (Fri), 4) Maria -> pre-cutover smoke plan & tracing TTL (Mon).
Alex: I'll update this thread with PR links and runbook patch when ready.
Jordan: Scheduled customer sync Tue 10am PT, I'll share calendar invite.
Maria: Thanks — I'll post the smoke checklist and validation commands. :thumbsup:
